summary: Thin cdecl delegation: forwards both incoming arguments (a1, a2) to sub_587D7F together with the fixed literal third argument 64, and returns sub_587D7F's result unchanged. Called from a wide range of file/settings loaders (ConfigIniParser, VehFileParser, AIDatabase_Init, file-open wrappers), consistent with a shared file-open/read-mode helper.

local_names.a1: forwarded first argument (typically a path or buffer)
local_names.a2: forwarded second argument (typically a mode or flag)

operations.description: Call sub_587D7F(a1, a2, 64), passing both incoming arguments plus the fixed constant 64 as the third argument.
Return the result of sub_587D7F unchanged.

unresolved: The fixed third argument 64 passed to sub_587D7F has no documented meaning in the packet (likely a buffer size or flag).
sub_587D7F is a mid-function entry of the neighboring routine; its own body is not in this packet, so the effect of a1/a2/64 is inferred only from the delegation shape.
